# OverSummoned

OverSummoned is a free desktop pet and idle game. Smudge, a hooded otter apprentice, guards a cursed ledger that summons people out of history. On the desktop he sits above the taskbar and works whenever you type: stamping the ledger to summon heroes, fishing, picking locks and digging in nine places from a Roman dock to an office supply closet. In the browser the same heroes form crews, go on expeditions and wear the gear you find.

- Home: https://oversummoned.com/
- Play in the browser: https://oversummoned.com/play
- 24 hero cards, each a different animal, each with three signature items
- Smudge has three voices: sweet, salty, and an adults-only unhinged mode
- The desktop app counts key presses only. It never records which keys.
